scope: All original16 targets; clean simulated observations; independent new stream models. No fusion, current-model external-target evaluation, real-sensor, or exploration-utility claim.

training_protocol.checkpoint_rule: strict minimum full validation loss; patience counts consecutive non-improving epochs
training_protocol.initialization: all stream trainable layers fresh; local pretrained frozen backbones only
training_protocol.data_split: unchanged CommonIndex target/scene split; all envs/views stay together
training_protocol.similarity_validation: mean of individual MSE for all five fixed reference views; deployment/test prediction uses center
training_protocol.test_rule: best validation checkpoint only, GT-free predictions saved before test scoring
training_protocol.augmentation: none; clean observed RGB-D; train similarity reference view sampled
training_protocol.optimizer: AdamW; independent model/optimizer/early stopping for each stream
training_protocol.original_changes: Similarity cap100->20 with cosine20; shared batch16/FP32; clip5; min3 and patience3 for all

test.aggregation: Equal image means; metric_valid_images excludes undefined subsets/empty IoU union. Camera views are grouped observations, not independent trials.

similarity.metric_note: MSE/MAE across pooled30x40 grid; positive/background subsets separately. Testcenter target reference; validation mean of5 reference-view losses.

test.aggregation: Equal image means; metric_valid_images excludes undefined subsets/empty IoU union. Camera views are grouped observations, not independent trials.

occlusion.metric_note: Raw-grid coverage-weighted MAE. IoU@0.5 within coverage>=0.5 patches; empty unions excluded with count2388. IoU is overlap, not accuracy.

test.aggregation: Equal image means; metric_valid_images excludes undefined subsets/empty IoU union. Camera views are grouped observations, not independent trials.

complexity.metric_note: PrimaryMAE and top20regret on valid & foreground_center grid positions. all_valid_MAE and zeroGTmeanprediction separately. Regionalcontinuousscore, not count/probability.

image_display.prediction: Actualfloat30x40 output bilinearly upsampled to640x480 for display
image_display.occlusion_postprocess: Fixed-camera workspace mask after expansion, independent of scene GT and coverage. Raw evaluation and predictions unchanged.

source_code_publication: Latest full-data runner, regional model implementation, weights, raw arrays and full dataset remain LOCAL. This summary is public evidence, not a self-contained training release.
